# Pickaxe

> Pickaxe is a free, open-source MCP (Model Context Protocol) server written in Rust. It lets AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI) study how software works - websites, web apps, desktop and phone apps, games, programs, files and APIs - with evidence for every answer, then helps rebuild your own version. Clean-room by default.

## Use it
- MCP server URL (no sign-in): https://pickaxe.run/mcp
- Claude: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector. ChatGPT: Settings > Plugins > Add custom MCP server (no authentication). Grok: Settings > Connect Apps > Add a custom connector.
- Hosted demo tool core_page_study reads any public web page (headers, scripts, forms, links, stack hints) without running it.
- Install locally (one command): https://pickaxe.run
